checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference in bot output.
bot claims a BOOKABLE program exists that is NOT one of: Adult Fundamentals BJJ, Kids 5-7 BJJ, Kids 8-13 BJJ. Flag source-bleed (Muay Thai, Striking, Eden/Hamptons/10P/Vacaville programs).
bot says 'you're booked'/'all set' WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first.

checkpoints.description: No hedge language on known negations
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'let me check'/'I'll look that up' where it should give a firm known answer.

checkpoints.description: Does not proactively volunteer non-bookable programs
checkpoints.look_for: bot brings up Adult BJJ Advanced, Fundamentals Live Training, or a Competition Class on its own without the lead asking.

checkpoints.description: No coach-redirect or substitute-calendar for non-bookable asks
checkpoints.look_for: when asked to book a non-bookable program, bot says 'discuss with the coach at your trial' OR books them into a different calendar as a substitute. Correct: 'not available to book online — new students start with a free trial in Fundamentals/Kids', no coach-redirect, no substitution.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before collecting personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks 'who is this for — you, a child, or both?' before collecting names/DOBs.

checkpoints.description: Collects DOB for all enrollees before booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks date of birth (not just age) before booking; age derived from DOB.

checkpoints.description: Pricing pressure redirected without giving a figure
checkpoints.look_for: lead pushes pricing 2+ times; bot firmly redirects, never gives a number.

checkpoints.description: Under-18 self-booker handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: contact themselves under 18 with no parent: bot does NOT book; captures kid+parent info, tags 'minor - needs guardian', closes with team-follow-up.

checkpoints.description: Adult (18+) routes to Adult Fundamentals BJJ
checkpoints.look_for: adult lead (18+ by DOB) booked into 'Adult Fundamentals BJJ'. Any other calendar is a routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Kid age 5-7 routes to Kids 5-7 BJJ
checkpoints.look_for: child aged 5-7 booked into 'Kids 5-7 BJJ'. Booking to Kids 8-13 or adult for this age is a routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Kid age 8-13 routes to Kids 8-13 BJJ
checkpoints.look_for: child aged 8-13 booked into 'Kids 8-13 BJJ'. Booking to Kids 5-7 or adult for this age is a routing failure. A 13-year-old IS in 8-13 → Kids 8-13 BJJ.

checkpoints.description: Age 14-17 has no calendar — no booking, referral
checkpoints.look_for: enrollee aged 14-17 must NOT be booked (kids cap at 13, adult floors at 18). Bot says no online slot for 14-17, tags 'minor - needs guardian', team will reach out.

checkpoints.description: Under age 5 redirected to gym contact
checkpoints.look_for: child under 5: bot does NOT book; states youngest is Kids 5-7 (Little Tigers) and suggests contacting the gym at (480) 270-6040.

checkpoints.description: Adult BJJ Advanced ask -> not available online, no coach redirect
checkpoints.look_for: lead asks to book Adult BJJ Advanced: bot states not available to book online, new students start with a free Fundamentals trial. No coach-redirect, no substitution.

checkpoints.description: Fundamentals Live Training ask -> not available online
checkpoints.look_for: lead asks about Fundamentals Live Training: bot states not available to book online, steer to a Fundamentals trial. No coach-redirect, no substitution.

checkpoints.description: Competition Class ask -> not available online
checkpoints.look_for: lead asks about a Competition Class: bot states not available to book online, steer to a Fundamentals trial. No coach-redirect, no substitution.
